sources.title: Jean-Luc Guermond, MATH 661 Fall 2025, Part VI, Chapter 27: Error analysis with variational crimes
sources.locator: Complete 14-page Chapter 27. Relevant ranges: §§27.1–27.2 (printed pp. 37–42), especially Lemmas 27.5 and 27.8 and their full proofs; §§27.4.1–27.4.2 (printed pp. 46–48), especially Lemmas 27.12 and 27.15 and their full proofs; Remarks 27.11, 27.13 and 27.17 for consistency conventions and limits of bounded extension.
sources.reading_evidence: The complete PDF was fetched and extracted with MuPDF. The exact assumptions, inf-sup stability, consistency functionals, best-approximation estimates, conforming quadrature version, nonconforming extension version, and caveat that a bounded extension is unavailable for some penalty/DG and point-quadrature methods were read. The local theorems independently prove their coercive Hilbert-space branches; no source claim substitutes for a local proof.

contents.name: Lemma 27.15, second Strang lemma with bounded extension, complete proof, and Remark 27.17

contents.name: Domain-geometry and quadrature discussion beyond the exact pullback identity

contents.name: Convergence discussion and examples not used as unconditional convergence claims
